desc:
⚔️ Welcome to Demon Arena! This is a Slayers vs. Demons PvP Arena! Unleash your skills and defeat your opposite! 

How to Play:
💪Choose your faction! Each faction has 8 unique fighting styles to master!
🔥 Train hard to strengthen your body and sharpen your combat skills!
👊 Defeat players from the opposing faction to earn Respect Points!
🏆 Climb the leaderboards! Prove you are the strongest!

In this war between Slayers and Demons, which side will you choose?

🔓 Code: NEW, 100likES
Next Code at 1k likes!

❤️ Love the Game? Support Us!
Like and favorite for updates! Join our group for exclusive CODES and new content!

🏷️ Tags:
PvP, Action, Combat, Simulation, Anime, Character Customization, Competitive

IMPORTANT: This game is an unofficial fan-made project inspired by Demon Slayer. It is created as a tribute to the anime and to share our love for it with the community.
